messages:
diane_cs: Quick follow-up from today's security review — they pressed on evidence export, chain-of-custody, and legal hold. We promised an export recipe and SIEM mapping. Who can draft the short runbook?

samir_sec: I'll draft the runbook. Core steps (short): 1) Initiate export ticket with retention-hold flag; 2) Run export CLI -> signed bundle; 3) Generate manifest (hashes + provenance); 4) Upload to customer-controlled S3 or provide signed URL; 5) Send proof-of-delivery (signed manifest + KMS signature). Link to template: https://confluence.redwood/sec/evidence-export-template

noah_infra: CLI example for engineering teams:
`redwood export-logs --tenant t-ACME --since 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --until 2026-03-18T23:59:59Z --format ndjson --sign --kms-key projects/acme/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck --out s3://acme-exports/redwood-4300/`
Note: the --sign step produces signed manifest.json and signature.sig

lucas_sre: Oncall checklist to attach to ticket:
- create INC-xxxx and set severity based on business impact
- pin retention-hold on tenant_id
- run export, verify manifest hashes match objects
- if exfil suspected, snapshot network flows and add to bundle
- notify CSM and legal

elaine_gov: Legal details: to accept export we need POA (power of attorney) or a signed data access request from customer's legal contact. For eDiscovery, include a chain-of-custody header in manifest:
{ "request_id": "REQ-20260318-99", "issued_by": "acme-legal@example.com", "received_ts": "2026-03-18T21:14:00Z" }
Also advise: once legal hold active, do not delete any logs until release order.

legal-bot: Note: Redwood Legal requires encryption of bundle at rest and transport; if customer requests HSM proof, escalate to private deployment sales path.

samir_sec: Chain-of-custody fields we include in manifest: origin, exported_by, export_tool_version, kms_key_id, signed_by, signature_blob_id, export_hash(es). Example manifest line:
{"bundle_id":"bndl-4300","tenant":"t-ACME","exported_by":"samir_sec","exported_at":"2026-03-18T21:20:03Z","signer":"projects/.../cryptoKeys/ck/cryptoKeyVersions/1","bundle_hash":"sha256:abcdef...","evidence_refs":["git+https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234"]}

noah_infra: SIEM field mapping sample:
- redwood_ts -> @timestamp
- actor -> user.name
- action -> event.action
- target -> target.id
Splunk example:
`index=redwood_audit sourcetype=rbac ndv=1 | table _time actor action target bundle_id`

samir_sec: Vulnerability triage policy (customer-facing summary): initial acknowledgement within 1 business hour, assign severity using CVSSv3; for exploits in the wild escalate to Critical; mitigation options include ACLs, patch, config rollback; we provide mitigations and timeline in ticket.

lucas_sre: For incidents where data exfil suspected, we also produce an immutable evidence bundle signed with KMS and publish a digest to our audit ledger (append-only). Customer can verify with their KMS public key if they used CMK.

diane_cs: Great. Deliverables: runbook md, CLI cheat-sheet, sample manifest & ndjson bundle (anonymized), SIEM mapping doc, legal template. Can we have a PR with these by EOD tomorrow?

samir_sec: Affirmative — PR by 17:00 PT. tagging @noah_infra and @elaine_gov to review.

noah_infra: Will review. small note: for hosted customers we can provide signed bundles but customer's ability to verify with their KMS public key requires they use customer-managed CMK.

diane_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll circle back with the customer with a short summary after we merge.
